t: You're looking at the Royal Automobile Club on Pall Mall, a clubhouse in Westminster. Three architects are credited with designing it: the French architect and interior designer Charles Mewès, the British architect Arthur Joseph Davis, and Edward Keynes Purchase. Mewès was born in 1858 and died in 1914, Davis lived from 1878 to 1951, and Purchase from 1862 to 1923. Beyond that, the material I have is thin, so take a moment to look at the frontage and see how the building presents itself to the street.
